name: navigator-isolation-coherence-test
body:
The coherence e2e test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `code_type = 'test'`) pins the navigator's session-isolation prose in the embedded `codebase-navigator.md` prompt, which pins the requirement `requirements.requirement.navigator-session-isolation`: each dispatch is a fresh, isolated session carrying no `task_id`; one dispatch is one self-contained unit of work; starting a new task is always a new dispatch, never a resume. The only permitted resume is the same-dispatch hand-back that finishes the same task and ends it. Resumption never starts a new or different task, never resumes a reviewer (each review round is a fresh dispatch), and is never carried across phases. The test also pins the motivation: subagent context is finite, and isolation — not reuse — is the design.

The component owns the test's session-isolation needle surface. It is distinct from `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`, which owns the prompt file 1:1 and is implemented-by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, and from the sibling `solution.component.navigator-scan-permission-coherence-test`, which owns the test's scan-permission needle surface. It sits under `solution.container.scanner-cli`, the root-crate test surface.

implemented-by: `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `code_type = 'test'`).
